name: Advanced Spell Pull
body:
Prerequisite(s): Int 16, Spell Pull

Benefit(s): At 9th level, an awakened animal companion may pull any spell its rider knows up to 4th level that does not require material components (or any spell if the rider has the Eschew Materials feat, unless the spell requires a component worth more than 1 gp).

Lost Lore: Horses of the Wild – Copyright 2014 Frog God Games; Author Rob Manning
